questions.question:
Select the word-pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the pair of words given below. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Seismology : Earthquakes
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Scientific study and its subject**.

Here,

Seismology : Earthquakes → **Seismology** is the scientific study of **Earthquakes**.

Similarly,

Ornithology : Birds → **Ornithology** is the scientific study of **Birds**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some soldiers are officers.

Some officers are civilians.

**Conclusions:**

I. All soldiers are civilians.

II. All civilians are soldiers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5535ae73923804268a7a49f000f9222e1966db0a4d7e059a88504e273fed487a.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All soldiers are civilians → Does not follow (As some soldiers are officers and some officers are civilians. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. All civilians are soldiers → Does not follow (As some soldiers are officers and some officers are civilians. So it is possible but not definite.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Dipan is an immediate neighbour of both Hansika and Gargi. Ekansh is sitting second to the left of Gargi. Iman is sitting third to the right of Hansika. Firoz is an immediate neighbour of both Ekansh and Hansika. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Dipan and Iman?
questions.solution:
**Given:** Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 

1) Ekansh is sitting second to the left of Gargi.

2) Dipan is an immediate neighbour of both Hansika and Gargi. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3082fd3c8400aa26c714d57f95a8727113d1f740f6a4770691b55230939a555.png] 

3) Iman is sitting third to the right of Hansika. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/798403a1bd535907d91cb497ae7a7addeea8376c6f1e5ec38dd839fa39870543.png] 

4) Firoz is an immediate neighbour of both Ekansh and Hansika. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0f74fe16a6f5b8e3de7f7e9189293d0c6c55203faa96efc3ec86911c97ef4df.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Gargi is an immediate neighbour of both Dipan and Iman.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
